'''June 2000 San Jose tournament (10 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Comics and Fantasies, San Jose, CA on 10 June 2000. [[Alfred Dong]] won it. It is known from Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d872">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-san-jose-ca-6-11d872/ san-jose-ca-6-11], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 11 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-san-jose-ca-6-11d872/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Comics and Fantasies, San Jose, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Alfred Dong]]
